name: GitHub issue to PR
description: Implement ready GitHub issues, address pull request feedback, and publish tested changes for review.
diagram:
flowchart TD
  A(["Scheduled scan"]) --> B{{"Ready issue or PR feedback?"}}
  B -.->|"no, next scan"| A
  B -->|yes| C["Agent implements and tests"]
  C --> D["PR opened or updated"]
exampleImplementation: A scheduled scanner selects every ready issue and each pull request whose exact head failed review. It submits one idempotent subject turn for each item. The profile-backed agent then clones the repository in its own runtime, implements or revises the change, tests it, pushes it, and requests independent review.

schedule.label: Check frequency
schedule.help: How often to look for newly labelled issues.

timezone.label: Timezone
timezone.help: Timezone the schedule is interpreted in.

repositories.label: Repositories
repositories.help: The repositories whose labelled issues OpenHands implements. Each is polled independently and keeps its own state, so issue numbers never collide between them.

triggerLabel.label: Trigger label
triggerLabel.help: OpenHands works only on issues carrying this label.

branchPrefix.label: Branch prefix
branchPrefix.help: OpenHands names branches using this prefix and the issue number, such as openhands/issue-42.

pullRequestMode.label: Pull request mode
pullRequestMode.help: Whether OpenHands should open the pull request as a draft or ready for review.

githubTokenSecret.label: GitHub token secret
githubTokenSecret.help: Name of a saved Agent Server secret. Include it in the selected profile so the delegated agent can use GitHub. On OpenHands Cloud and Enterprise, leave the default when GitHub is connected: if this secret is not set, the token from your GitHub sign-in or Settings > Integrations is used. On a local Agent Canvas this secret is required.

setup.message: Configure the repositories, labels, branch prefix, pull request mode, agent profile, and schedule.
